name: John Squier
title: Director of Educational Technology (Global)
quote:
We worked with Mohammed on a major project to move our data pipelines from Tibco to AWS Glue. It was a complex task with a tight deadline, but Mohammed handled it with great organization and calm focus.

He broke the migration into clear steps, shared progress regularly, and always made sure everyone understood what was happening next. His careful planning meant that when challenges came up, we could solve them quickly without slowing the project down.

Thanks to Mohammed's hard work and steady communication, the entire migration finished on time—before our Tibco contract ended—and with no disruption to our daily operations. He's reliable, easy to work with, and truly takes ownership of his work. I'd be glad to work with him again.
